summary.name: KiCad
summary.one_liner: KiCad is a cross-platform, open source PCB design suite with tools for schematic capture, PCB layout, and 3D viewing.
use_cases: designing a first printed circuit board
drawing electrical schematics with hierarchical sheets
laying out complex PCBs with interactive routing
rendering realistic images of a finished board
summary.what_it_does: KiCad includes a Schematic Editor that handles simple to hierarchical designs with hundreds of sheets, with custom symbols and an official library. It has an integrated SPICE simulator and electrical rules checker for verifying designs. The PCB Editor offers an interactive router and selection and visualization tools for layout. The 3D Viewer lets users inspect boards, check mechanical fit, and render images with a built-in raytracer and customizable lighting.
notable: Integrated SPICE simulator and electrical rules checker
Built-in raytracer with customizable lighting in the 3D Viewer
Official symbol library with thousands of symbols
